title: Spikers' Turf: King Crunchers cruise past Cabstars to stay unbeaten
summary: Criss Cross rested some key players but still had little trouble in a 25-15, 25-12, 25-20 sweep of AEP-Cabstars in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at the Filoil Centre.
